mapper.sql: from cms_mwo m join mst_equip e on e.equip_id = m.equip_id left join cms_fail_code fs on fs.fail_id = m.symptom_id left join cms_fail_code fc on fc.fail_id = m.cause_id left join cms_fail_code fa on fa.fail_id = m.action_id left join sys_user u on u.user_id = m.assignee_id left join lateral (select sum(l.minutes) as minutes from cms_mwo_labor l where l.mwo_id = m.mwo_id) lb on true where m.mwo_type = 'BM' and m.status in ('DONE', 'CLOSED') and e.plant_cd = #{plantCd} and coalesce(m.down_start_at, m.reported_at) >= #{from} and coalesce(m.down_start_at, m.reported_at) < #{until} and (e.equip_cd like #{keyword} escape '\' or e.equip_nm ilike #{keyword} escape '\') and e.class_id = #{classId}
mapper.select:
select m.equip_id, count(*) as failures, coalesce(sum(floor(extract(epoch from m.down_end_at - m.down_start_at))) filter (where m.down_yn = 'Y'), 0)::bigint as down_sec, count(*) filter (where m.down_yn = 'Y') as down_count, coalesce(sum(floor(extract(epoch from m.started_at - m.reported_at))), 0)::bigint as resp_sec, count(m.started_at) as resp_count
group by m.equip_id
mapper.sql: case when m.down_yn = 'Y' then floor(extract(epoch from m.down_end_at - m.down_start_at))::bigint end
mapper.select:
select as key_cd, max() as key_nm, count(*) as failures, coalesce(sum(), 0) as down_sec
group by order by count(*) desc, coalesce(sum(), 0) desc, nulls last

select u.login_ide.equip_cd as key_cd, max(u.user_nme.equip_nm) as key_nm, null::bigintmax(e.equip_id) as equip_id, count(*) as failures, coalesce(sum(), 0) as down_sec, count(*) filter (where m.down_yn = 'Y') as down_count, coalesce(sum(floor(extract(epoch from m.started_at - m.reported_at))), 0)::bigint as wait_sec, count(m.started_at) as wait_count, coalesce(sum(floor(extract(epoch from m.finished_at - m.started_at))), 0)::bigint as repair_sec, count(m.started_at) filter (where m.finished_at is not null) as repair_count, coalesce(sum(lb.minutes), 0) as labor_min, count(lb.minutes) as labor_count
group by 1 order by count(*) desc, 1 nulls last

with f as ( select m.mwo_id, m.equip_id, e.equip_cd, e.equip_nm, m.cause_id, fc.fail_cd as cause_cd, fc.fail_nm as cause_nm, coalesce(m.down_start_at, m.reported_at) as fail_at
and m.cause_id is not null ), l as ( select f.*, lag(f.fail_at) over (partition by f.equip_id, f.cause_id order by f.fail_at, f.mwo_id) as prev_at from f ) select equip_cd, max(equip_nm) as equip_nm, cause_cd, max(cause_nm) as cause_nm, count(*) as repeats, max(fail_at) as last_at, floor(extract(epoch from min(fail_at - prev_at)))::bigint as min_gap_sec from l where fail_at >= #{periodFrom} and prev_at is not null and fail_at - prev_at <= make_interval(days => #{days}) group by equip_cd, cause_cd order by count(*) desc, max(fail_at) desc, equip_cd, cause_cd limit 200

select m.mwo_id, m.mwo_no, m.status, m.title, e.equip_cd, e.equip_nm, coalesce(m.down_start_at, m.reported_at) as fail_at, fs.fail_cd as symptom_cd, fs.fail_nm as symptom_nm, fc.fail_cd as cause_cd, fc.fail_nm as cause_nm, fa.fail_cd as action_cd, fa.fail_nm as action_nm, as down_sec, floor(extract(epoch from m.started_at - m.reported_at))::bigint as wait_sec, floor(extract(epoch from m.finished_at - m.started_at))::bigint as repair_sec, u.user_nm as assignee_nm
and is null = #{key} order by coalesce(m.down_start_at, m.reported_at) desc, m.mwo_id desc limit #{limit}
